name: Mark a task-comment as complete
description: Mark a task-comment as complete Mark a task-comment as complete. POST /api/projects/{project_id}/comments/{id}/complete/
context:
POST /api/projects/{project_id}/comments/{id}/complete/
Mark a task-comment as complete. Sets completed_at and completed_by. 400 if the comment is not a task or is already complete.
Required: id (path) — A UUID string identifying this comment.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.

name: Create a comment
description: Create a comment Create a comment. POST /api/projects/{project_id}/comments/
context:
POST /api/projects/{project_id}/comments/
Create a comment. Support messages are deduplicated: an identical message from the same author on the same ticket within a short window returns the original comment with a 200 instead of creating a second one, and a 409 while a concurrent request is still creating it.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: body (body)

name: comments_list
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/comments/
comments_list
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: completed (query) — When kind=task, restrict to open (incomplete) or completed tasks. Ignored when kind is not 'task'. Defaults to 'any' (no filter). * `any` - any * `open` - open * `completed` - completed; created_by (query) — Filter by the numeric ID of the user who wrote the comment.; cursor (query) — The pagination cursor value.; item_id (query) — Filter by the ID of the resource being commented on.; kind (query) — Filter by comment kind. 'task' returns only items intentionally created as actionable. 'comment' excludes tasks. Defaults to 'any' (no filter). * `any` - any * `comment` - comment * `task` - task; scope (query) — Filter by resource type (e.g. Dashboard, FeatureFlag, Insight, Replay). Support-ticket scopes (Ticket, conversations_ticket) additionally require ticket API scope access.; search (query) — Full-text search within comment content.; source_comment (query) — Filter replies to a specific parent comment.; task_id (query) — Owning task for task, task_artifact, and desktop_canvas comment scopes.

name: Mirror this discussion thread to a Slack channel
description: Mirror this discussion thread to a Slack channel Mirror this discussion thread to a Slack channel. POST /api/projects/{project_id}/comments/{id}/send_to_slack/
context:
POST /api/projects/{project_id}/comments/{id}/send_to_slack/
Mirror this discussion thread to a Slack channel. Posts the comment (and its existing replies) as a new Slack thread; later replies on either side sync across. A discussion mirrors to exactly one Slack thread: re-calling with the same channel returns the existing mirror; a different channel is a 400 naming the existing one. 409 while a concurrent send is in flight. 404 when the feature is not enabled for the team.
Required: id (path) — A UUID string identifying this comment.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.; body (body)
